env_files.role: Campaign assignment, launch date, visible copy, creative direction and claim boundaries
Brand identity, layout, product imagery and nutrition-claim guidance
Platform profiles plus revision-status history; latest pre-freeze state controls
Creative asset ledger containing legacy and neutral-ID pilot assets with approval, campaign, placement, market, and validity fields
Candidate logos, packshots, backgrounds, badges and food photographs
120 release packages, versioned package-status events, and resolution notes; the final package overrides the older brief
120 activation packages, status history, preparation catalog, offer terms and claim-panel catalog

source_policy.web_usage_note: Closed-env case: the agent must solve only from task.md and env/. The stock images have already been downloaded into the asset library.

notes: The final solution is a desk-trial activation that supersedes the earlier Apple Crunch Pilot. Consumer copy and assets must be resolved across four workbooks.
difficulty_design: A versioned placement profile, release package, retail activation package and asset state must each be resolved at the creative freeze.
The final activation adds preparation steps, promo code, fulfillment terms and household limit that are absent from the base campaign brief.
High-similarity legacy, superseded and post-freeze packages contain nearly identical Apple Crunch wording but different values.
The asset register exceeds 240 real files and includes role, campaign, placement, market, date and status near-misses.
Grounded VQA groups multiple exact fields per item; score 2 requires complete agreement rather than approximate campaign similarity.
